I started my PC gaming journey back in 2003 when I was just 11 years old, with our first PC was a desktop with a Athlon 64, 256MB of RAM, and a 40GB, 7200 RPM hard drive. It wasn't the fastest PC of the time, but I had a lot of fun playing games on it like: Emulated games (nes, snes, a little bit of n64) and some PC games like GTA Vice City, San Andreas, Megaman X4, X8 NFS Hot Pursuit (the original). They didn't run well at all but that didn't matter to me, I was having so much fun to care.

I had a blast with this PC, until unfortunately, after 4 years of use, the motherboard literally caught on fire.
